headline: HSBC Q3 Net Profit Surges 45.5% to Miss Estimates; Hang Seng Unit Merger Planned
summary: HSBC reported a 45.5% increase in third-quarter net profit, missing analyst forecasts amid ongoing restructuring. Separately, HSBC plans to merge Hang Seng Bank's investment arm into its asset management business.
why: HSBC Holdings is one of the world's largest global banking institutions, with extensive operations across Asia and Europe.

impacts.name: HSBC Holdings plc
impacts.why: Third-quarter net earnings came in below consensus analyst expectations.

why_moved: Net profit fell short of analyst forecasts despite strong year-on-year growth.
